# Every `git push` and `gh pr create` in skills/, commands/, agents/, hooks/, lib/ and bin/ (CCW-145, C6).
# Format: <file>|<command>|<count>|<class>|<reason>
# class lead: the lead role pushes and creates the PR; a `switch-role lead` comes before the site
#   in the same code block on a multi-role devbox (a block under "If single-role devbox" has none).
# class other: not a lead PR; the reason says why.
# The test fails when a site is not listed here, or when a count differs.
skills/develop/SKILL.md|git push|8|lead|Step 6 push, the Step 6.5 CI-fix push, the Step 7 fix-round push (multi- and single-role blocks each) and the two re-push sequences under PRs already in flight
skills/develop/SKILL.md|gh pr create|3|lead|Step 6 (multi- and single-role blocks) and the recreate sequence under PRs already in flight
skills/release/SKILL.md|git push|1|lead|the catalog bump PR is a lead PR
skills/release/SKILL.md|gh pr create|1|lead|the catalog bump PR is a lead PR
skills/land/SKILL.md|git push|1|other|pushes the session's own branch at session end; opens no PR and is not a PR head the review gate reads
skills/autonomous-worker-loop/SKILL.md|git push|1|other|runs in a worker pod, where the worker token is the only identity; a PR opened there is authored by the review identity, so the lead closes and recreates it with the lead role (develop, PRs already in flight)
skills/autonomous-worker-loop/SKILL.md|gh pr create|1|other|runs in a worker pod, where the worker token is the only identity; a PR opened there is authored by the review identity, so the lead closes and recreates it with the lead role (develop, PRs already in flight)
skills/onboard/SKILL.md|git push|1|other|prose only: "Never run git push against gitops repos"
skills/team-retro/SKILL.md|git push|1|other|prose only: a retro table row about silent push failures
